sloka: न हि राज्यमधर्मेण भोक्तुं क्षणमपि त्वया ।शक्यं मूर्खसहायेन पापेनाविदितात्मना ।। ६.४१.६८ ।।।।
transliteration: na hi rājyamadharmeṇa bhoktuṁ kṣaṇamapi tvayā ।śakyaṁ mūrkhasahāyena pāpenāviditātmanā ।। 6.41.68 ।।।।

translations.english: "If you do not seek my protection I will devoid this world of Rakshasas with my sharp arrows."
